summary: The daily answers check no longer reports a key that gained a claim after the cut on one member: members that computed their answers minutes apart differed only in such keys, so busy kinds would have raised a false answers-disagreement fault after two hours

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; only the check's comparison changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; summary and bucket digests are the same as before.

compatibility.detail: Answer keys gain an optional moving field that older members ignore. A pair with an older member still sees these differences until both run this build.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.
